_comment: This file is the source of truth for the dashboard. It's overwritten automatically by scripts/sync_tripit_calendar.py once TRIPIT_ICAL_URL is set up (see README), or you can edit it by hand right here in GitHub any time before that. Dates are ISO 8601 in the airport's/hotel's local time, with an explicit timezone offset.
